derivation: Setup: the budget registers two exact class/envelope authorizations, license-class-authorization for the original envelope and license-class-authorization-revised for a revised envelope whose only change is temporal_validity.valid_from 2026-09-07T06:00:00Z (still before the 2026-09-10T04:30:00Z clock). reserve-a was reserved under the original envelope. The revised authority input rebinds every dependent digest (acts, returns, host selection, operation digest), keeps the proposal byte-identical, and has an exact registered authorization, so the authority input alone is ready. A matching SETTLE then leaves reserve-a SETTLED at revision 3. The case: RENEW supplies the revised authority input with the current settled history. Both INPUT_INVALID (terminal target) and OCCURRENCE_CONFLICT (changed envelope) apply. RES-WIRE-004 (owner decision G1): a RENEW whose explicit reservation is SETTLED or RELEASED is INPUT_INVALID, checked after current-history dependency, authentication and type admission and before the proposal and envelope check. RES-WIRE-004 fixes the phase-5 code order DEPENDENCY_MISMATCH, EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE, UNSUPPORTED_RELATION, REFERENCE_INVALID, BINDING_MISMATCH, TYPE_INVALID, INPUT_INVALID, LIMIT_EXCEEDED, DEFINITION_CONFLICT, OCCURRENCE_CONFLICT, RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND, ADMINISTRATION_NOT_ESTABLISHED. The terminal check precedes the envelope check on both grounds, so the result is INPUT_INVALID. RES-003 and RES-WIRE-004: an admission refusal creates no receipt, advances nothing and returns the exact supplied state and digest, so the reservation keeps its status, permit and evidence.
